title: --problem-name is ignored when resolving a problem directory
reasoning: The command promises an explicit problem-name override, but the value is only logged. Problem resolution receives the submission directory and catalog root without the override. Supplying --problem-name therefore cannot change the selected problem, causing renamed submission directories to fail resolution or use an unintended problem.
reproduction: Evaluate a submission directory whose basename differs from the intended catalog problem, supplying that problem with --problem-name. Resolution receives exactly the same arguments as when the option is omitted.
recommendation: Use the explicit problem name to resolve the catalog configuration when supplied, and infer from the submission directory only when omitted.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The included tests exercise evaluate_agent_run, not evaluate_problem_dir or its problem-name override.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover explicit and inferred problem selection, including a submission basename that names a different valid catalog problem, and assert which configuration reaches evaluate_checkpoint.
minimumFixScope: Problem resolution in evaluate_problem_dir and focused command coverage.

history.reasoning: Both original evidence ranges still exist. eval_problem_dir.py:128-132 now forwards problem_name, and evaluation/utils.py:45-76 prefers that explicit name over the submission basename.
